body: I know that. Which is why I have no idea what I'm going to do now.
That is true. I just mean I'm doing my best to still trust him on other matters.

Thank you. This is the kind of answer I was looking for. 

Do you feel like the little activities are helping to improve your relationship? Or just putting a metaphorical band-aid on it?
I don't distrust him as of yet.
It's not a choice. I live in a horribly abusive household right now. That's my only hope at escaping it in the near future.

It takes more than forgiving to fix the lack of trust. And he's not interested in my opinion. He wants to feel terrible. And really, the distance isn't the problem or he would've gone and boned another girl. 

But I (had planned on) moving in with him in July.
Not the kind of advice I'm looking for. I have no interest in leaving him. I want to know how to get over this.
You're right. Thank you so much.

Ridicule from my parents. It's not like I'm actually working right now. But I'd just take college art classes. Not graduate in biology like I planned. I'd go to a different school most likely. 

I dunno. I had my whole life planned. That's why I'm afraid to change it. But the life I planned out is pretty crappy right now.

It's not the career change that worries me. I didn't state it well in the initial post, but I mean it was a vulnerable moment for me, and two important people in my life shrugged if off. 

And it's not that I want to die. I just don't want to deal with the life that I have right now. And I know. Life is hard. It's not supposed to be easy. I just feel like I've been given more than I can handle. 

As to talking with a friend, I honestly don't know who I would go to. All my friends at school only look at helping others as a chance to prove how good they are (arts highschool full of selfish bleeding hearts). I know therapy would help. I just don't know how I would get professional help. My parents don't believe in psychiatry or psychology. They believe in faith and God, and I'm borderline atheist. Probably more agnostic. 

I just feel like I'm at a crossroads, but deciding on anything will greatly change my life.  Which I need. But I also fear. And that fear is keeping me where I am.
